schema: LLM Sizer benchmarks.json v1 — one row per measured configuration; tg = decode tok/s, pp = prefill tok/s; weights_gb = loaded weight size for the quant (decimal GB); active_weights_gb = the active weights a mixture-of-experts model re-reads per token; runtime = llama.cpp-gguf | mlx | sglang (only llama.cpp-gguf rows calibrate); accel = none | mtp | dspark | dflash | dflash2; accel rows carry baseline_tg = the same setup without acceleration; optional build = runtime build or commit; optional context_tokens = tokens already in context when tg was measured (absent = short prompt); optional role = floor-fit marks rows added for the fixed-cost speed model (F16 / Q8_0 / other GPU bins of the 7B table): they enter the per-chip floor fit but not the legacy efficiency median, which stays on its 0.8 row set until the multiplier model is removed; rows with role = prefill carry a pp figure, params_active_b and arch_class only (community rows): they calibrate the prefill terms and enter no decode fit; prefill_depth_sweeps = pp512 at several context depths, one entry per published sweep; cluster_series = one entry per published multi-machine run, tokens per second by machine count in tg_by_nodes (prefill in pp_by_nodes where it was published) with the link, the split (layer | tensor), the runtime and the architecture class: these calibrate the cluster block only and enter no single-machine fit, and a series marked report_only has no one-machine point of its own runtime (or changes quant with the count), so it is quoted and never fitted
